screenshot-创建课程.title: Create Course
steps: Click [Create Course].
Click the [Create] button to complete creation and open the teacher development center.
Click [Enter Course Editing].

screenshot-删除课程.title: Delete Course
steps: Click [Delete Course].
After clicking [Delete Course], a pop-up window appears. Deleting the course cannot be undone.

screenshot-如何从课件库导入课件.title: How to Import Courseware from Courseware Library
steps: Click [Import from Courseware Library]. The current course has no courseware imported yet. You can import from files or the library.
Select the courseware you want to import.
Click [Import] to complete the operation.

screenshot-如何使用教师备课助手.title: How to Use the Teacher Lesson Preparation Assistant
steps: Click to enter the course.
Click on the Workbench, then Resources, then Discussion, then Teacher Lesson Preparation Assistant, and select Teacher Lesson Preparation Assistant.
Enter the dialog and generate a knowledge graph.
Click the arrow icon.
Click A, then Lesson Preparation Assistant 1, then Lesson Preparation, then Save, then Publish, then Workbench 0.
Click Download to save the outline to the local Workbench 0, Resources 0, Discussion, Exam, Project, Lesson.
Click Publish; a pop-up window will appear. Click Save, then Publish, then Workbench.
Click Resource 1, enter a keyword in the text box to see the newly generated outline, then add resources.

screenshot-如何创建AI助手.title: How to Create an AI Assistant
steps: Enter the course's AI Workbench and click the plus sign in the assistant area.
Enter the Manage My AI Assistants page.
Click Create AI Assistant and select Manual Creation.
Fill in the assistant name, description, and instructions.
Configure the knowledge base, workflow, and avatar as needed, then save and publish.
Return to the AI Assistant management page and confirm the new assistant appears in the list.

screenshot-如何创建单元-导入课件生成单元.title: How to Create a Unit - Import Courseware to Generate a Unit
steps: Click to enter the course.
In the pop-up window, select Import Courseware to Generate Unit under Teaching Activities.
Click Import Courseware to Generate Unit.
Click Import.

screenshot-如何删除公告.title: How to Delete an Announcement

screenshot-如何在课堂中打开资源.title: Open a Resource in Class
steps: Click [ Start Class ].
Click [ Open Resource ].
Select the file you need for class, then send it to the student AI Workbench.

screenshot-如何导入自己的课件.title: How to Import Your Own Courseware
steps: Click Resource Library, then click Upload File, Create Time, Add Folder, Upload File, Add, and Add.
After clicking “Upload File”, this pop-up window will appear: Resource Library Type, enter search keyword 2.

screenshot-如何开始上课.title: How to Start a Class
steps: Open [Classroom] from the course menu, then click [Create Classroom].
In the dialog, configure the classroom session and confirm the course and teaching content.
Click [Start Class] when the session is ready.
Enter the live classroom and begin teaching.

screenshot-如何批量导入班级与学生.title: How to Batch Import Classes and Students
steps: Open the class import tool and choose to import classes and students from another course.
Select the source course and the classes or students to copy, then click [Confirm].
Alternatively, choose to import students from the student library and select the required students.
Click [Confirm] to finish importing the selected classes and students.

screenshot-如何新建公告.title: How to Create a New Announcement
steps: Click to enter the course.
Click Announcement 1 No Announcement C to Publish New Announcement 2, then click Publish New Announcement 0.
After clicking “Publish New Announcement”, this pop-up window will appear: Resource 0 口 0 囗.
Publish here. Course administrators can publish announcements to all classes, instructors.

screenshot-如何新建课件.title: How to Create New Courseware
steps: Open [Courseware] in the course workspace, then select [Edit My Courseware].
On the My Courseware page, click [Create Courseware].
Enter a courseware name in the dialog, then click [Create Courseware] to continue.
Enter or paste the chapter outline, then click [Create] to generate the structure; you can also publish directly.
Add and edit the page content, click [Save], then select [Return to Courseware Home].
Review the generated chapters on the courseware home page, then click [Publish].
Select the publishing site in the dialog and click [Publish] to confirm.
Click [Return to My Home] and verify that the new courseware appears with a Published status.

screenshot-如何新建题库文件夹.title: How to Create a New Question Bank Folder
steps: Open [Exam] from the course menu, then enter [Question Bank].
Click [Add] and choose [Add Folder].
Enter the folder information in the dialog and confirm to create the question-bank folder.

screenshot-如何添加AI助手至AI工作台首页.title: How to Add an AI Assistant to the AI Workbench Homepage
steps: Enter the target course's [AI Workbench] and open [Settings].
In the AI Assistant area, click [Add AI Assistant].
Select the AI assistant to add to the homepage and confirm.
Return to the settings page and confirm the assistant status is [Enabled].
Return to the AI Workbench homepage and confirm the newly added assistant is displayed.

screenshot-如何设置教学团队-创建班级.title: How to Set Up a Teaching Team - Create a Class
steps: Click to enter the course.
Click 'Create Class'. You can batch create classes. Enter the class name and teacher sequence number.
Click 'Enter class name here'. Each line represents one class. Enter the classes you want to create.

screenshot-如何设置教学团队-加入学生-学生扫码.title: How to Set Up a Teaching Team - Add Students via QR Code
steps: Go to the class management page and open the student entry for the target class.
Click the class QR code so students can scan it with the uLearning App to join the class.

screenshot-如何设置教学团队-加入学生-老师添加.title: How to Set Up a Teaching Team - Add Students Manually
steps: Click 'Add Student'. Confirm the class is created successfully. You can assign students or specify a teacher to delete the class.
After clicking 'Add Student', this popup appears. Tip: Students need to...

screenshot-如何设置教学团队-指定教师.title: How to Set Up a Teaching Team - Assign a Teacher
steps: Click 'Assign Teacher' to delete the class.
After clicking 'Assign Teacher', this popup appears. You can directly assign exams, assessments, or other items.

screenshot-新增AI助手中-选择AI助手.title: Add an AI Assistant - Select an AI Assistant
steps: Go to the course's 'AI Workbench' and click the plus icon in the assistant area.
Select 'Choose AI Assistant'. In the popup, check an existing assistant.
Click 'Confirm'. Return to the workbench to verify the assistant is now displayed.
